name: Dual Enrollment and Merced College Classes (Merced Union High School District)
org: Merced Union High School District and Merced College
what_you_do: Earn college credit in high school three ways: online CCAP classes made for high schoolers, Merced College classes taken outside the school day, or college courses built into select high school classes.
who_can_apply: Students in good academic standing at a Merced Union High School District school (Atwater, Buhach Colony, El Capitan, Golden Valley, Livingston, Merced, Sequoia, Yosemite). Complete the Merced College application, a parent consent form and a High School Permit.
pay_detail: Free: students can take college courses at no cost, up to 11 units a semester. Textbook fees are waived for CCAP classes; textbook fees apply for concurrent enrollment.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the district page; check with your school's Pathway Counselor.
how_to_apply: Apply to Merced College, submit the parent consent form and High School Permit, and talk to your school's Pathway Counselor.
notes: College privacy law applies once you enroll: parents do not get progress updates from Merced College. A college GPA below 2.0 can affect future college eligibility and financial aid.
